source: https://www.onlyworlds.com/api/v2/openapi.json: the 22 categories' write schemas, <Category>Write (POST, PUT) and <Category>Patch (PATCH)

write.says: A full {type} write (POST creates; PUT creates or fully replaces, resetting omitted fields to empty). Any key that is neither a field below nor an extension field (atlas_*, shadow_*, x_*) is a 422, including the server-managed type, created_at, updated_at and change_seq.

^(atlas_|shadow_|x_).description: Extension field, stored opaquely and returned verbatim (any JSON value; at most 65536 bytes of extensions per element, counted as compact UTF-8 JSON).

id.description: POST: optional client-minted id (any RFC 4122 UUID; the server mints a UUIDv7 otherwise). PUT/PATCH: ignored, the path id wins.

name.description: Name of the element. null stores ''.

description.description: Any kind of details about the element. null stores ''.

supertype.description: The top level classification of the element within its type. null stores ''.

subtype.description: The sub level classification through which the element is further sorted within its type. null stores ''.

image_url.description: URL to an image representing the element. null stores ''.

world.description: Tolerated and ignored: the API-Key decides the world.

created_by.description: Tolerated and ignored: the server records who created an element.

changed_by.description: Tolerated and ignored: the server records who last changed an element, and through which door.

changed_via.description: Tolerated and ignored: the server records who last changed an element, and through which door.

changed_client.description: Tolerated and ignored: a client names itself in the X-OW-Client header, never in the body.

hidden.description: On a create (POST, a PUT whose id is new, or a /bulk item that creates): true creates the element hidden from its first moment. Only the world's owner key or a co-builder's (a person's or a seat's) may send it; any other key is refused (403 hidden_not_allowed) and nothing is created. The element is never served to a reader who cannot see hidden elements, and /changes never carries its body to them: a contributor gets one delete row with reason `hidden` at the element's change_seq, a guest nothing; the owner and co-builders get it with `hidden: true`. false, null or absent: a visible element, as ever. Any other value is a 422 on a create. Where the server has the hidden mark switched off, true is a 422 (param hidden) and nothing is created. On a PUT that replaces an existing element it is ignored: hide and unhide through PUT and DELETE /{type}/{id}/hidden.

x_served_trimmed.description: Refused (422 served_trimmed_not_writable): served only, see the Narrative read schema (a message) and the Construct read schema (a lens).

patch.says: A partial {type} write (PATCH): omitted fields are untouched; arrays replace; extension fields merge by key. Any key that is neither a field below nor an extension field (atlas_*, shadow_*, x_*) is a 422, including the server-managed type, created_at, updated_at and change_seq.
